newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Carulla raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Carulla raised to buy.

text.p: -- ING Barings said on Thursday analyst Alejandra Torres upgraded her rating for Colombian supermarket chain Carulla y Ca SA to buy from hold.

-- "The change has been made on the basis of upside on stock price and revised EPS estimates following company management's announcement that Carulla will not issue its customary 20 percent stock dividend in 1997," Torres wrote in a report.
-- Torres revised Carulla's EPS estimates upward to $0.37 from $0.34 in 1997 and to $0.34 from $0.26 in 1998.
